items.title: Base change for all proper morphisms reduces to the projective line over every base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is a reduction step for the proof of general proper base change: it shows that it suffices to know the statement for the projections P^1_S -> S (statement lines 18538-18543). The proof (proof lines 18545-18607) localises on the base, applies Chow's lemma to obtain a closed immersion of X' into a projective bundle together with the proper surjective pi, and uses the sandwich, finite and composition principles twice to reduce first to the projections P^n_S -> S and then, through the explicit factorisation using the polynomial display, to P^1_S -> S. H2: a chain of named reductions, each written out.
